description: Discovers Figma identifiers from supported file, design, board, prototype, slides, team and project URLs, and can list team projects, project files or file nodes. Project and file listing failures may appear as empty results.

inputSchema.description: Request to discover Figma resources and extract IDs automatically.

figma_url.description:
Full Figma URL to extract file_key, node_id, and team_id from. Works with any Figma URL format:
• File: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/Design-Name
• Design: https://www.figma.com/design/ABC123/Design-Name
• Board: https://www.figma.com/board/ABC123/Board-Name
• Prototype: https://www.figma.com/proto/ABC123/Prototype-Name
• Slides: https://www.figma.com/slides/ABC123/Slide-Name
• With node: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/Design?node-id=123:456
• Team: https://www.figma.com/files/team/123456/Team-Name
This is the easiest way to get all IDs you need! Node IDs in URLs use hyphens (123-456) but Figma JSON uses colons (123:456) — convert format when passing to other tools. If extracted_ids.file_key returns null, parse it manually from the path segment after /file/, /design/, /board/, /proto/, or /slides/.
figma_url.title: Figma Url

file_key.description: File key to extract all node IDs from. Get this from file URL (figma.com/file/FILE_KEY/...) or from project files list. Returns hierarchical list of all nodes with IDs, names, types, and paths.
file_key.title: File Key

max_depth.description: Maximum tree depth to traverse when discovering nodes. 2=pages+frames, 3=pages+frames+components, etc. Higher values find more nodes but take longer. Responses at depth 4+ or broad file_key traversal can exceed 20k tokens with significant latency; cap at 2–3 and target specific CANVAS or FRAME node IDs to limit response size.
max_depth.title: Max Depth

project_id.description: Project ID to list all files from. Get this from project URL or from team projects list. Returns files with keys, names, and thumbnails.
project_id.title: Project Id

team_id.description: Team ID to list all projects from. Get this from team URL: https://www.figma.com/files/team/YOUR_TEAM_ID/Team-Name. Returns list of projects with IDs and names. Cannot be inferred from user identity or figma.get_current_user; must come from a team URL or be provided directly.
team_id.title: Team Id
